Step 3:  This can be calculated using combinations, denoted as $\binom{n}{r}$, which represents the number of ways to choose $r$ items from a set of $n$ items without considering the order.
Step 4:  In this case, we have $\binom{24}{12}$ ways to choose 12 vertices from the set $S$.
